meta.name: Bone-Riveted Contour Loupe
meta.description: An expensive, rare surveyor's package constructed with sturdy rivets. Upon reading this manual, you gain the ability to permanently read z-depth and HP via a target loupe, and reveals precise chalk line contours for early strata planning. However, its fine optics grant a slight luck bonus only in the deep dark where depth exceeds 30.
